Kind words from our customers

Questions, answered

How do I order?

Add packs to your order, tap the order bar at the bottom of the screen, then press "Send order on WhatsApp". Your order arrives in our chat and we reply to confirm.

How do I pay and get delivery?

We confirm payment details and delivery to your area on WhatsApp once we receive your order.

How do I cook with it?

Soak the pieces in warm water for a few minutes, rinse, and add to soups, stews and sauces. Cooking time depends on the dish.

How should I store it?

Press the air out and reseal the pouch after opening, and keep it somewhere cool and dry.

Do you supply caterers and resellers?

Yes. Our 20 and 50-pack bundles are made for larger orders. Message us and we will agree the supply with you.

Ready to stock your kitchen?

Send us a message and we will help you pick the right size.
